response.reason: The kernel quantizes the softmax probabilities to fp16 (p.to(fp16)), giving each p_i a relative error up to ~2.4e-4 (RMS ~1.4e-4). Since the workload centers V so the reference output is shrunk by (1 - center) = 0.1, the expected relative output error is ~1.4e-4/0.1 ≈ 1.4e-3, which exceeds the 1e-3 budget; the fp16 round-trip is the dominant error source and is likely to violate E <= 0.001 on this workload.
